name.full: Assetfy: Official real estate data for Germany and Austria

description.short: Parcels, zoning plans, land values and buildings for Germany and Austria
description.full: Ask Copilot about an address, a Flurstück (cadastral parcel) or a property listing in Germany or Austria. Assetfy answers from official data: parcel size and outline, Bebauungsplan (zoning plan) with its documents, Bodenrichtwert (official land value), GRZ/GFZ, buildings with eaves and ridge height, terrain, 3D building models, aerial images and property listings. Every parcel links to the Assetfy map. All tools are read-only; nothing is created or changed in your account. Requires an Assetfy account with a PROFESSIONAL or ENTERPRISE plan (assetfy.com/pricing).
